name: The Scarab God
aliases: the one with the scarab head
description: A scarab-shaped dark god who leads the Eternals out of the central mausoleum.

timeline.summary: Three sarcophagi along the Necropolis crack open and three insect-headed gods awaken.
timeline.quote: three enormous figures stepped forward from their slumber, awakened by the demon's spell.

timeline.summary: The scorpion god tears the serpent in two and advances while the other two gods enter Naktamun.
timeline.quote: the other two gods crossed the threshold of the gate into the city of Naktamun.

timeline.summary: Bolas leaves to find the scarab god as undead swarm and drag down Bontu.
timeline.quote: flying toward the gate and the waiting scarab god.

timeline.summary: The scarab god leads thousands of blue-glazed Eternals, including past champions, out of the mausoleum.
timeline.quote: in the wake of his implacable dark divinity, came an army.

relations.note: leads the army out of the mausoleum
relations.quote: in the wake of his implacable dark divinity, came an army.

pages_say.description: A god with the azure carapace of a scarab for a face who awakens from the Necropolis alongside the other two.
The third insect-headed god, an indigo statue who stands motionless before the Gate as Bolas flies to him.
A scarab-shaped dark god who leads the Eternals out of the central mausoleum.
A dark god who woke the Eternals and attacked the city.
